verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents public APIs. The CKS API lets you create, list, update and delete managed Kubernetes clusters. The Inference API gives programmatic control over gateways, model deployments and capacity claims, with Bearer-token auth and generated clients for Go, Python, TypeScript and other languages. A FOCUS API (Public Preview) handles usage export. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, explicit API coverage for other surfaces such as node pools, SUNK and quotas (cluster creation docs list only Console/Terraform).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The API lets you create, list, update, and delete managed Kubernetes clusters on CoreWeave infrastructure.
The CoreWeave Inference API provides programmatic control over inference gateways, model deployments, and capacity claims.
All API requests must include a CoreWeave API access token in the Authorization header as a Bearer token.
Clients are available for the Connect, gRPC, and Protobuf ecosystems across languages including Go, Python, TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Rust, and Swift.
You can also export usage programmatically with the FOCUS API (Public Preview)
